rules.title: Assembly Bill 12
rules.requirement: Since July 1, 2024 landlords may generally charge a security deposit of no more than one month's rent for furnished and unfurnished units. Small landlords may charge up to two months' rent. Deposits must be returned within 21 days with an itemized statement, and photographs and proof of repairs are required.
rules.key_value: 1 month's rent (2 months for small landlords)
rules.status_basis: Page states the law changed deposit amounts starting July 1, 2024.

exempt_if.text: landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total

exempt_if.name: small_landlord_natural_person_ownership
exempt_if.text: ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC where all members are natural persons

coverage.summary: Applies to California residential landlords generally.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Small landlords owning two properties with no more than four units total may charge up to two months' rent.

rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance security deposit interest
rules.requirement: Landlords of units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance must pay tenants interest on security deposits at the end of each year, and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before year end.
rules.status_basis: Described as a current requirement under the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.

requires.name: covered_by_berkeley_rent_ordinance
requires.text: units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance

coverage.summary: Applies to tenancies in units covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
